title: Python Polymorphism
text:
Python
Polymorphism



The word "polymorphism" means "many forms", and in programming it refers to
methods/functions/operators with the same name that can be executed on many
objects or classes.

Function Polymorphism

An example of a Python function that can be used on different objects is the

len()
function.

String

For strings
len()
returns the number of characters:

Tuple

For tuples
len()
returns the number of items
in the tuple:

Dictionary

For dictionaries
len()
returns the number of key/value pairs
in the dictionary:
